tools.name: tender_search_notices
tools.description: Search/filter German public procurement notices by keyword, CPV, Bundesland, type, buyer, value, published date, or submission deadline. [German public procurement (oeffentlichevergabe.de, CC0)]

tools.name: tender_get_notice
tools.description: Get one notice by notice id or OCID. [German public procurement (oeffentlichevergabe.de, CC0)]

tools.name: tender_get_stats
tools.description: Aggregate counts by type, category, Bundesland and CPV division over the current data window. [German public procurement (oeffentlichevergabe.de, CC0)]

tools.name: tender_health
tools.description: Service status and data freshness (notice count, data_window, updated_at). [German public procurement (oeffentlichevergabe.de, CC0)]

tools.name: mastr_search_units
tools.description: Search/filter MaStR energy units by PLZ, type, status, capacity (kW), Bundesland, or keyword. [German MaStR energy units (DL-DE-BY-2.0, © Bundesnetzagentur)]

tools.name: mastr_get_unit
tools.description: Get one unit by MaStR Einheit number (e.g. SEE…). [German MaStR energy units (DL-DE-BY-2.0, © Bundesnetzagentur)]

tools.name: mastr_get_stats
tools.description: Aggregate counts by type, status and Bundesland over the current snapshot. [German MaStR energy units (DL-DE-BY-2.0, © Bundesnetzagentur)]

tools.name: mastr_health
tools.description: Service status and data freshness (unit count, updated_at, license). [German MaStR energy units (DL-DE-BY-2.0, © Bundesnetzagentur)]

tools.name: ladesaeulen_search_stations
tools.description: Search/filter German EV charging stations by PLZ, Bundesland, power (kW), fast/normal, plug type, operator, payment, city, radius around lat/lon, or bounding box. [German EV charging stations (Ladesäulenregister, CC BY 4.0, Bundesnetzagentur.de)]

tools.name: ladesaeulen_get_station
tools.description: Get one charging station by Ladeeinrichtungs-ID. [German EV charging stations (Ladesäulenregister, CC BY 4.0, Bundesnetzagentur.de)]

tools.name: ladesaeulen_get_stats
tools.description: Aggregates by Bundesland, kW bucket, plug type and top operators. [German EV charging stations (Ladesäulenregister, CC BY 4.0, Bundesnetzagentur.de)]

tools.name: ladesaeulen_health
tools.description: Service status and data freshness (station count, data date, license). [German EV charging stations (Ladesäulenregister, CC BY 4.0, Bundesnetzagentur.de)]
